core_mechanistic_localization.level_1_behavioral_switch: Rainfall-associated change is dominated by 0-to-positive recruitment, not intensification of already-active cells.
core_mechanistic_localization.level_2_chorus_strength: Most recruitment slope is 0-to-CallingIndex-2/3; 0-to-CI3 full chorus itself is positive and robust to same observer plus physical stop identity.
core_mechanistic_localization.level_3_recurrent_template: Recruitment overwhelmingly revisits species-site combinations already observed in prior years; exact-site species-specific history predicts wet strong/full chorus beyond generic frog-hotspot quality and neighborhood proximity.
core_mechanistic_localization.level_4_geometry_residual: Local memory, species-specific rain response and their cross-fit additive/gating combinations all remain insufficient to reproduce the original four-component matrix geometry.
core_mechanistic_localization.level_5_depth_sufficiency: Once observed wet species identity and each species' wet occupied-stop count k are conditioned exactly, the original four-component geometry is nonexceptional under both history-weighted and persistence-weighted placement models.
core_mechanistic_localization.level_6_depth_predictor: Among wet-recruited species, broader prior route-scale strong-chorus SiteID templates predict larger current k and especially third-plus spatial depth, with a positive prior-breadth x rain-contrast interaction.

species_fixed_k_conditional_null.boundary: This is a response-conditioned diagnostic. It localizes the missing structure to species identity plus spatial activation depth k; it is not a predictive or causal null.

prior_spatial_template_depth.sensitivity_boundary: Same-observer and exact-consecutive-year subsets failed their prefixed route-count gates and were not interpreted. This model conditions on wet-side recruitment, so a symmetric wet-vs-dry discordant-species test is pending.

limits: Four-plus-year durable-memory tests failed their prefixed route gates; do not claim >=4-year persistence.
Recurrence-frequency dose-response failed its prefixed route gate by 5 routes; do not claim dose response.
Persistent local population versus species-specific microhabitat remains unresolved.

spatial_depth_decomposition.interpretation: The unusual structure is activation depth across third and later stops, not an unusual choice or clustering of stops conditional on k.

ruled_out_or_not_sufficient: Species-specific rain response plus prior local memory.
A single cross-fit rain-by-memory gating term.
Simple recruitment toward already-active chorus stops.
Strong-chorus mediation by NWI hydroperiod or Palustrine versus Riverine/Lacustrine class.
Simple temperature x rain or seasonal-window x rain gating.
Observer turnover, physical stop relocation, measured hearing/noise/wind differences, or weak-CI1-only detection.
Special Euclidean clustering of occupied stops conditional on species k.

generality.NAAMP_domain: Strong activation is leave-one-state-out robust but state-specific effects are heterogeneous.
generality.taxonomic: Local species-site template is positive in 19/20 estimable taxa; pooled result survives every one-species omission.

pending.within_pair_template_release: Symmetric wet-only versus dry-only discordant-species test of whether prior spatial breadth is preferentially expressed on the wetter side.
pending.purpose: Remove the main selection limitation of the prior-breadth depth model.

current_best_hypothesis: Rain acts as a temporal gate that releases a recurrent species-specific spatial activity template. The distinctive matrix signature is produced mainly by coherent species-level activation depth: once recruited, a species expresses its historical route-scale footprint across multiple stops, especially third and later stops and usually at overlapping/full-chorus intensity. The proximal physiological cue and the origin of state-level heterogeneity remain unresolved.
